subject: Acceptance window rephase & compact risk log
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harthospitals.org>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@harthospitals.org>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP / evaluation window

Sean —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement pushed our vendor review into week of Aug 24 due to a backlog on legal paperwork and a required SOC2 evidence pass. That means our original MAP acceptance date (Sept 15) is now at risk.

Can we rephase the MAP and evaluation window by 2–3 weeks? The hospital can still commit to functional evals starting Sept 1, but the formal acceptance window will need to move. We need a short risk log we can share internally (procurement & security) that explains mitigations and any go/no-go triggers.

Also: procurement asked for a short addendum (pricing hold during the rebaseline) while they finish the review — they want something in writing for their exec review.

Appreciate a quick turnaround on a compact MAP + risk note.

Best,
Liam
Director, Vendor Ops
Hartford Regional Health

--
Attachment: initial_MAP.pdf (stub)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harthospitals.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP / evaluation window

Liam —

Thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear procurement is backlogged. We can absolutely rephase; I sketched a compact rebaseline below and attached a 1-page MAP_v2 that highlights the shifts and mitigations.

Proposed quick rebaseline (compact):
- Functional eval start: 2026-09-01 (unchanged)
- Formal acceptance window: move from 2026-09-15 -> 2026-10-06 (three-week shift)
- Canary/go-live: targeted 2026-10-20 (tied to successful SLA/canary results)

Top risks and mitigations (short log):
1) Procurement approval delay -> Mitigation: price-hold addendum (60-day lock) + expedited SOC2 packet (attached).
2) Integration test failure -> Mitigation: 2-week dedicated integration sprint; rollback playbook with previous model pin.
3) UAT engagement drop -> Mitigation: weekly checkpoints, named stakeholders and escalation point.

I'll attach MAP_v2.xlsx (one-pager), SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf, and a draft price-addendum-draft.docx for procurement to review. If procurement needs a one-line exec summary we can provide that today.

Request: Can Ben/Marissa and legal review the addendum language and confirm we can hold pricing for 60 days while they complete internal approvals? If yes I'll send a succinct exec note for Liam's procurement packet.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

--
Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (stub); SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf (stub); price-addendum-draft.docx (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harthospitals.org>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance window rephase & compact risk log

Team —

I reviewed Sean's addendum draft. High level: we can offer a 60-day price lock on the quoted committed capacity as long as the scope doesn't expand (same model, same token profile). A few notes:
- Procurement will need a one-paragraph explanation of why the lock exists and a signature block for the finance lead.
- If acceptance slips beyond the 60 days we should include an escalation clause (exec review for pricing adjustment).
- Recommend we put a simple trigger: if DocuSign not completed by 2026-10-06 -> auto-escalate to Sales Director for decision.

Irene: can you own the short SOC2 evidence push (confirm which artifacts are required by Aug 18)? Marissa: can you coordinate with Legal on the addendum wording? I can draft the finance paragraph.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Operations
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

--
Quick reply: agree with proposed mitigation steps.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harthospitals.org>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance window rephase & compact risk log

All —

I can loop Legal in and have a tight addendum (pricing hold + trigger language) ready for review by EOD Wednesday. We should keep the language simple: 60-day hold, same scope, escalation trigger to Sales Director after that period.

Operational ask: can we offer a small canary (non-production subset) that allows them to demonstrate integration progress during the review window? If procurement accepts the canary as evidence of progress, it may accelerate approvals.

I'll prepare the canary plan (1–2 endpoints, no PHI, shared test dataset) and the addendum draft.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachment: canary_plan.md (stub)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harthospitals.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance window rephase & compact risk log

Liam / Procurement —

Summary / next steps (compact):
- We will move the formal acceptance window to 2026-10-06 (three-week rephase).
- Redwood provides: MAP_v2 one-pager, SOC2 evidence packet, 60-day pricing hold addendum (draft attached).
- Canary offer: limited test endpoints (no PHI) to demonstrate integration progress during review.
- Triggers: if DocuSign not completed by 2026-10-06 -> automatic escalation to Sales Director for pricing decision.

Action items:
1) Liam: confirm procurement will accept the canary as interim evidence and if they need the 1-line exec summary for their packet.
2) Irene: confirm SOC2 artifact list by Aug 18.
3) Marissa/Legal: finalize addendum text by EOD Wed (we will share an annotated version in HubSpot and DocuSign).
4) Ben: prepare finance paragraph and escalation instructions for the addendum.

I'll send the short exec summary once Legal confirms the addendum language. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Sean
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
